description: Test-feedback gradient at stages 1-10 under the revised oracle and the bash default timeout (image 0.4): the starter baseline (tests on demand through test_visible), tests-none (withheld), and tests-pushed (on demand plus a failure-level report pushed by the harness about every 10 minutes), every other factor held at the starter baseline. The v8 batch runs baseline and tests-pushed; tests-none has v6 data under the same harness (picc-tests-v3). Co-primary endpoints on the last buildable snapshot as well as the final one.

conditions.description: Behavioral specification in TASK.md, detailed workflow prompt, failure-level test tool, empty Rust repository, and no reference implementation.
Withhold visible tests and all visible scores while retaining post-hoc hidden evaluation.
Tests on demand as in baseline, plus the harness runs the visible tests about every 10 minutes and delivers the same failure-level report unprompted.
